items.title: Louis Tio Interview, 1960-10-26
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] There's another sister that married, I know, one of the Boccage brothers. [INTERVIEWEE] Mrs. Song saxophonist. They were from Mexico.

ctx.x: That's my sister. That's the youngest one of all.
There's another sister that married, I know, one of the Boccage brothers.
